_comment: AP-79 40 MHz rollback of the target (houdini-dualband.json) [user: 50 MHz target, 40 MHz rollback if the link at 50 disappoints on the bench]: sub-6 2400 to 2440 MHz at NCO 2420, 106 RB = 1272 subcarriers = 38.16 MHz. Everything else as the target.
_status: RUNNABLE in software, NOT YET RUN on the rig (AP-79): every key is consumed, the TX interpolator, TX prefilter, RX channel filter and band-limited beacon are in, and the replay strobe contract at vld 2 is confirmed by the software and fpga lanes. Carried calibrations (tx_advance, corr_scale) are re-measured at the first run.
_rates_note: sample_rate stays 122.88e6: it is the RX rate AND the device tick, and every slot/frame count below is in those ticks. The TX stream runs at tx_sample_rate; every TX waveform is generated at 122.88 and x2 interpolated at the radio boundary (include/dsp/band_filters.h). DAC 5898.24 / interpolation 24, ADC 4915.2 / decimation 40.
_frequency_note: Common NCO is the sub-6 2425 MHz; only the X-band channels override it (TX ch1 = B, RX ch2 = C). Zone, ADC calibration mode, inverse sinc and the +-25 MHz RX channel filter are DERIVED per channel from the NCO and the converter rates (PG269 rules), not configured: sub-6 -> zone 1, cal mode 1, filter on; X-IF -> zone 2, cal mode 2, filter off. frequency is the carrier the CFO ppm is quoted against (the sub-6 beacon link).
_gain_note: Written explicitly on every opened channel: make() now resets RX DSA to 0 dB and TX VOP to 20 mA. TX 0 dB = maximum VOP, where the software lane measured linearity (W2). The ue_*_gain_* fields below are Iris units and inert on Houdini.
_numerology_note: 5G-like, fixed CP [user; plan section 3.3]: SCS 30 kHz = 122.88 MHz / 4096, CP 288 (NR normal), symbol 4384 ticks. 14 symbols = 61376 ticks + zero prefix 32 + postfix 32 = 61440 ticks = exactly 0.5 ms (NR's slot) = 160 x 384, so every slot starts on the 384-tick TDD grid, as the old 1 ms frame did. 1596 data subcarriers = 133 RB = 47.88 MHz (+-23.94, inside the +-24 MHz filter passband). This IS the 40 MHz rollback: 1272 subcarriers = 106 RB = 38.16 MHz at NCO 2420.
_schedule_note: B, G, P, U then guards: 20 slots x 0.5 ms = 10 ms (NR's radio frame). The UE sends its pilot in slot 2 and uplink data in slot 3 on BOTH its TX channels (sub-6 and X-IF; the BS separates them by channel, as in AP-78's shared pilot slot).
_beacon_note: nr_pss_bl: the band-limited beacon (AP-79): the 127-tone NR PSS at 240 kHz (512-point, +-15.2 MHz) behind NR's 36-sample CP, then a guarded TRS pair on the central 96 tones of a 256-point symbol (+-23 MHz); 1076 ticks, inside the replay RAM at TX 245.76. The argmax pick: the shipped first_path rule lands 2 samples early on this lobe, which is about 8 samples wide (beacon_bandlimit_test).
_carried_note: Carried from the last demo and to be RE-MEASURED at mode V before trusting: tx_advance 247 is the 122.88/NCO-500 bench calibration (the mode-V converter pipelines differ); corr_scale/corr_scale_init were measured on the legacy beacon (a detector ratio is not an absolute). ue_pilot_horizon counts FRAMES: 96 x 1 ms was 96 ms of lead, so it is 10 x 10 ms here.
